title: Introduce affordance catalog and release autosummary for onboarding
author: Priya Anand
description: Context: onboarding churn has made changelogs noisy and hard to consume. We frequently get follow-up questions from SRE/Platform about model affordances (what features a model supports: structured output, function-calling footprint, KV cache behavior) and matching those to performance profiles. This PR introduces two related pieces: 1) an explicit affordance catalog in the model registry that records per-model supported features, confidence hints and lightweight compatibility notes; 2) a release autosummary that synthesizes concise release notes from the onboarding metadata, profile deltas and sampled perf snapshots. Motivation: make release notes machine-readable and human-friendly, reduce reviewer overhead during onboard reviews, and surface potential regressions early via template-driven summaries. What changed (summary): added a new registry table and protobuf for affordance_catalog, an onboarding hook that populates catalog entries during intake, a delta-analyzer that compares previous profile seeds to the incoming profile and emits structured delta tags, and a release-autosummary generator that produces a short human summary plus a compact changelog fragment for downstream release channels (Console, changelog service). This PR also adds test coverage, console docs, and a migration to backfill affordances for recent models. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (PM-122) [x] affordance protobuf + migrations [x] onboard hook to populate/validate [x] autosummary generator + templates [x] unit + integration tests [x] console docs and short runbook [x] backfill job and monitor. Backwards compatibility: affordance entries are additive and optional, older models without affordance rows will still be served; autosummary output is optional and gated behind a feature flag for 2 weeks. Rollout: feature_flag onboard_affordance_catalog=false by default, enable in staging for 48h, then enable in production as read-only for 7 days, then enable write path and backfill. Security/Compliance: no model weights or PII are emitted; only metadata and sampled perf aggregates are used. Related work: follows patterns from ENG-2198 (profile-delta-scoring) and references prior release automation experiments (ENG-4310).
commit_summary: feat: onboarding hook to infer and validate affordances
feat: delta-analyzer to produce compact affordance+perf diffs
test: unit + integration tests for catalog + autosummary
docs: console pages and runbook for affordance catalog
diff_snippets: registry/protos/affordance_catalog.proto: message Affordance { string name = 1; repeated string hints = 2; float confidence = 3; map<string,string> meta = 4; }
onboard/release/autosummary_generator.rs: // template: {{model}} - delta: {{delta_summary}} - perf: {{perf_change}} -- generates a 2-3 line bullet for changelogs
review_comments: Mateo Cruz: Can the affordance confidence be derived from telemetry instead of heuristics? Priya: We added a telemetry hook but gated it behind opt-in; initial inference is heuristic + rule-based with a confidence float so we can replace source later.
Jordan Lee: Autosummary looks great; please ensure the generator never emits exact prompt examples. Priya: Confirmed, autosummary strips prompt examples and uses aggregated sample counts only.
Samantha Park: migration concerns for large registries? Priya: migration script runs in batches, we've throttled it and added a monitoring metric (migration.affordance.backfill.progress).
Mateo Cruz: small nit on template wording for Console UI (prefer 'Behavioral hints' -> 'Affordance hints'). Priya: updated the template and console copy in docs.
release_notes:
- Introduce an affordance catalog for models (records features, hints, and confidence)
- Autosummary generator that synthesizes concise release notes from onboarding metadata and perf deltas
- Backfill job to populate affordance entries for recent models
- Console docs and runbook to operate affordance backfills and feature flags
notes_for_backport: No API breaking changes. Backport only migrations and protobuf if releasing registry v1.2 branch. Ensure migration is run with the same throttling parameters.
test_plan: Unit tests cover parser and heuristics. Integration tests run a full onboarding flow with a synthetic profile and assert an autosummary is generated. Backfill tested on a snapshot DB before prod run. Staging rollout for 48h to validate metrics (autosummary.count, affordance.backfill.error_rate).
observability_changes: Added metrics: affordance.inferred.count, affordance.backfill.progress, autosummary.generated.count, autosummary.template.errors. Added logs at INFO for backfill milestones and WARN for template generation failures.
